thought.title: clippedswiglu Cs Chunk 64→512 (8X Chunk) + Exp-Based Silu + Cast Reduction
thought.description: Three synergistic changes: (1) CS_CHUNK 64→512 reduces loop iterations 8x. (2) Tanh sigmoid replaced with Exp-based SiLU (4 vs 4 ops, but Exp < Tanh latency on 910B). (3) Eliminated redundant Cast for x2Orig copy, reducing Cast from 3 to 2 per chunk.
thought.reason: Chunk: 64→512. Sigmoid: [Muls(0.5)+Tanh+Adds(1)+Muls(0.5)+Mul] → [Muls(-1)+Exp+Adds(1)+Div]. Buffer: w2 reused in-place (up→SiLU→clip), removing w3 x2Orig copy. Net: 9→8 vector ops/chunk with 8x fewer iterations. S2 speedup: 2.25x, S3: 2.29x.
